title: Low-disk owner notice that pauses snapshots and model downloads
goal: Below the threshold NERV notifies the owner once and skips the snapshot and model downloads until space returns
acceptance: One notice per low-disk episode and one when space returns
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: statfs reader, threshold, notice. Not a measurement.
